43401.meaning1: complete comprehension; full understanding; comprehensive knowledge (of)

examples.text: evaṃvādiṃ kho maṃ, bhikkhave, evam'akkhāyiṃ eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā asatā tucchā musā abhūtena abbhācikkhanti, samaṇo gotamo na kāmānaṃ pariññaṃ paññāpeti, na rūpānaṃ pariññaṃ paññāpeti, na vedanānaṃ pariññaṃ paññāpetī'ti.
katamā ca, bhikkhave, pariññā? rāgakkhayo, dosakkhayo, mohakkhayo, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, pariññā
saññaṃ pariññā vitareyya oghaṃ, pariggahesu muni n'opalitto, abbūḷhasallo caram'appamatto, n'āsīsatī lokam'imaṃ parañ'cā'ti.

43403.meaning2: known for certain, comprehended, known accurately

examples.text: yesaṃ sannicayo n'atthi, ye pariññātabhojanā, suññato animitto ca, vimokkho yesaṃ gocaro, ākāse va sakuntānaṃ, gati tesaṃ durannayā.
viññāṇe, bhikkhave, āhāre pariññāte nāmarūpaṃ pariññātaṃ hoti, nāmarūpe pariññāte ariyasāvakassa n'atthi kiñci uttarikaraṇīyan'ti vadāmī'ti.

43404.meaning1: fact of (something) being fully understood; complete comprehension (of)
43404.commentary: (NIDD1a) kodhavatthussa pariññātattā'ti kodhassa patiṭṭhābhūtassa kāraṇabhūtassa piy'āpiya-aṭṭhānasaṅkhātassa vatthussa ñātatīraṇapariññāhi byāpetvā ñātabhāvena.

examples.text: tassa kāye kāy'ānupassino viharato kāyo pariññāto hoti. kāyassa pariññātattā amataṃ sacchikataṃ hoti.

yassa so kodho pahīno samucchinno vūpasanto paṭipassaddho abhabbuppattiko ñāṇ'agginā daḍḍho, so vuccati akkodhano. kodhassa pahīnattā akkodhano, kodhavatthussa pariññātattā akkodhano, kodhahetussa upacchinnattā akkodhano'ti, akkodhano.

43405.meaning1: completely comprehended to the end; understood to the full extent

examples.text: pathaviṃ pathavito abhiññāya pathaviṃ na maññati, pathaviyā na maññati, pathavito na maññati, pathaviṃ me'ti na maññati, pathaviṃ n'ābhinandati. taṃ kissa hetu? pariññāt'antaṃ tathāgatassā'ti vadāmi.

examples.text: yesaṃ sannicayo n'atthi, ye pariññātabhojanā, suññato animitto ca, vimokkho yesaṃ gocaro, ākāse va sakuntānaṃ, gati tesaṃ durannayā.

examples.text: katamo ca, bhikkhave, pariññātāvī puggalo? arahātissa vacanīyaṃ. yv'āyaṃ āyasmā evaṃnāmo evaṃgotto, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, pariññātāvī puggalo'ti

pariññādisutta + āni

n'āhaṃ sabbe samaṇabrāhmaṇāse, jātijarāya nivutā'ti brūmi, ye s'īdha diṭṭhaṃ'va sutaṃ mutaṃ vā, sīlabbataṃ vā'pi pahāya sabbaṃ, anekarūpam'pi pahāya sabbaṃ, taṇhaṃ pariññāya anāsavāse, te ve narā oghatiṇṇā'ti brūmi.

examples.text: so'pi pathaviṃ pathavito abhijānāti, pathaviṃ pathavito abhiññāya pathaviṃ mā maññi, pathaviyā mā maññi, pathavito mā maññi, pathaviṃ me'ti mā maññi, pathaviṃ m'ābhinandi. taṃ kissa hetu? pariññeyyaṃ tassā'ti vadāmi.
yā c'āvuso, paññā yañ'ca viññāṇaṃ, imesaṃ dhammānaṃ saṃsaṭṭhānaṃ no visaṃsaṭṭhānaṃ paññā bhāvetabbā, viññāṇaṃ pariññeyyaṃ. idaṃ nesaṃ nānākaraṇan'ti.

43423.meaning1: being burnt; being tormented; being afflicted; being distressed (by)

examples.text: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, kumāra, api nu tassa gahapatissa vā gahapatiputtassa vā uppajjeyyuṃ rāgajā pariḷāhā kāyikā vā cetasikā vā yehi so rāgajehi pariḷāhehi pariḍayhamāno dukkhaṃ sayeyyā'ti?
so aññe satte passāmi kāmesu avītarāge kāmataṇhāhi khajjamāne kāmapariḷāhena pariḍayhamāne kāme paṭisevante. so tesaṃ na pihemi, na tattha abhiramāmi.

43427.commentary: (VIN 1.4.3.10) pariṇataṃ nāma dassāma karissāmā'ti vācā bhinnā hoti.

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu jānaṃ saṅghikaṃ lābhaṃ pariṇataṃ attano pariṇāmeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.

43428.commentary: (MNa) niyatisaṅgatibhāvapariṇatā'ti ettha niyatī'ti niyatatā. saṅgatī'ti channaṃ abhijātīnaṃ tattha tattha gamanaṃ. bhāvo'ti sabhāvo'y'eva. evaṃ niyatiyā ca saṅgatiyā ca bhāvena ca pariṇatā nānappakārataṃ pattā. yena hi yathā bhavitabbaṃ, so tath'eva bhavati. yena no bhavitabbaṃ, so na bhavatī'ti dassenti.

examples.text: n'atthi balaṃ, n'atthi vīriyaṃ, n'atthi purisathāmo, n'atthi purisaparakkamo, sabbe sattā sabbe pāṇā sabbe bhūtā sabbe jīvā avasā abalā avīriyā niyatisaṃgatibhāvapariṇatā chasv'ev'ābhijātīsu sukhadukkhaṃ paṭisaṃvedentī'ti.
katame pañca? sappāyakārī hoti, sappāye mattaṃ jānāti, pariṇatabhojī ca hoti, kālacārī ca hoti, brahmacārī ca. ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca dhammā āyussāti.

43432.meaning1: perceiving as allocated; regarding (something) as designated

examples.text: pariṇate pariṇatasaññī attano pariṇāmeti, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
devaṭṭhāne mantito attho garukaṃ pariṇamati, panthe mantito attho tuccho bhavati, saṅgāme cañcalo bhavati, udakatitthe pākaṭo bhavati.

na khv'āhaṃ taṃ, brāhmaṇa, passāmi sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya, yassa so pāyaso bhutto sammā pariṇāmaṃ gaccheyya, aññatra tathāgatassa vā tathāgatasāvakassa vā.

yaṃ ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ tejo tejogataṃ upādinnaṃ, seyyath'idaṃ, yena ca santappati yena ca jīrīyati yena ca pariḍayhati yena ca asitapītakhāyitasāyitaṃ sammā pariṇāmaṃ gacchati… ayaṃ vuccati, rāhula, ajjhattikā tejodhātu.

pittasamuṭṭhānāni'pi… semhasamuṭṭhānāni'pi… vātasamuṭṭhānāni'pi… sannipātikāni'pi… utupariṇāmajāni'pi… visamaparihārajāni'pi… opakkamikāni'pi… kammavipākajāni'pi kho, sīvaka, idh'ekaccāni vedayitāni uppajjanti.

addhānakkhamo hoti, padhānakkhamo hoti, app'ābādho hoti, asitaṃ pītaṃ khāyitaṃ sāyitaṃ sammā pariṇāmaṃ gacchati, caṅkam'ādhigato samādhi ciraṭṭhitiko hoti. ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca caṅkame ānisaṃsā'ti.

yaṃ ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ tejo tejogataṃ upādinnaṃ, seyyath'idaṃ, yena ca santappati yena ca jīrīyati yena ca pariḍayhati yena ca asitapītakhāyitasāyitaṃ sammā pariṇāmaṃ gacchati … ayaṃ vuccati, rāhula, ajjhattikā tejodhātu.

examples.text: idaṃ me, bhante, jānaṃ saṅghikaṃ lābhaṃ pariṇataṃ attano pariṇāmitaṃ nissaggiyaṃ. im'āhaṃ saṅghassa nissajjāmī'ti

43444.meaning1: developing (into); ripening (in); culminating (in); maturing (in); inclining towards
43444.commentary: (DNa) vossaggapariṇāmin'ti ettha dve vossaggā pariccāgavossaggo ca pakkhandanavossaggo ca. tattha vipassanā tadaṅgavasena kilese ca khandhe ca pariccajatī'ti pariccāgavossaggo. maggo ārammaṇavasena nibbānaṃ pakkhandatī'ti pakkhandanavossaggo. tasmā vossaggapariṇāmin'ti yathā bhāviyamāno satisambojjh'aṅgo vossagg'atthāya pariṇamati, vipassanābhāvañ'ca maggabhāvañ'ca pāpuṇāti, evaṃ bhāvetī'ti ayam'ettha attho.

examples.text: katame ca, bhikkhave, āsavā bhāvanā pahātabbā? idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu paṭisaṅkhā yoniso satisambojjh'aṅgaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ
yo pana bhikkhu jānaṃ saṅghikaṃ lābhaṃ pariṇataṃ attano pariṇāmeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
yo pana bhikkhu samaggena saṅghena cīvaraṃ datvā pacchā khīyanadhammaṃ āpajjeyya, yathāsanthutaṃ bhikkhū saṅghikaṃ lābhaṃ pariṇāmentī'ti, pācittiyaṃ.

43447.meaning1: wanting to transfer; wanting to divert (to)

examples.text: bhūtapubbaṃ, ambaṭṭha, rājā okkāko yā sā mah'esī piyā manāpā, tassā puttassa rajjaṃ pariṇāmetu'kāmo jeṭṭhakumāre raṭṭhasmā pabbājesi, okkāmukhaṃ karakaṇḍaṃ hatthinikaṃ sinisūraṃ.
bhūtapubbaṃ, ambaṭṭha, rājā okkāko yā sā mah'esī piyā manāpā, tassā puttassa rajjaṃ pariṇāmetu'kāmo jeṭṭhakumāre raṭṭhasmā pabbājesi, okkāmukhaṃ karakaṇḍaṃ hatthinikaṃ sinisūraṃ.

43450.meaning2: changed into, appropriated, turned to somebody's use

43452.commentary: (ANa) pitiṭṭhāne ṭhitattā saṅghaṃ pariṇenti, pubbaṅ'gamā hutvā tīsu sikkhāsu pavattentī'ti saṅghapariṇāyakā.

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu… na titthaṃ jānāti, na pītaṃ jānāti, na vīthiṃ jānāti, na gocarakusalo hoti, anavasesadohī ca hoti, ye te bhikkhū therā rattaññū cirapabbajitā saṅghapitaro saṅghapariṇāyakā te na atirekapūjāya pūjetā hoti.
yāvakīvañ'ca bhikkhave bhikkhū ye te bhikkhū therā rattaññū cirapabbajitā saṅghapitaro saṅghapariṇāyakā te sakkarissanti garuṃ karissanti mānessanti pūjessanti tesañ'ca sotabbaṃ maññissanti

43453.meaning1: counsellor treasure; one of the seven treasures of a universal ruler
43453.commentary: (DNa) aggamahesiyā kucchimhi nibbattitvā sakalarajjam'anusāsana-samatthaṃ jeṭṭhaputtasaṅkhātaṃ pariṇāyakaratanaṃ pātubhavati.

examples.text: tass'imāni satta ratanāni bhavanti, seyyath'idaṃ, cakkaratanaṃ, hatthiratanaṃ, assaratanaṃ, maṇiratanaṃ, itthiratanaṃ, gahapatiratanaṃ, pariṇāyakaratanam'eva sattamaṃ.
tassa mayhaṃ, bhikkhu, rañño sato khattiyassa muddh'āvasittassa caturāsītikhattiyasahassāni ahesuṃ anuyantāni pariṇāyakaratanappamukhāni.

43454.meaning1: with the counsellor treasure as the foremost (among them)

43455.meaning1: having a counsellor; with a strategist

examples.text: rājā'va khattiyo muddh'āvasitto pariṇāyakasampanno, tass'ime cattāro dhammā vimuttiṃ paripācenti. so iminā vimuttipañcamena dhammena samannāgato yassaṃ yassaṃ disāyaṃ viharati vimuttacitto'va viharati.
pariṇāyakasampannā, sahitā ekavādino, te maṃ samaggā hiṃseyyuṃ, tasmā nesaṃ na patthaye.
na pāṇidaṇḍehi pan'ātha leḍḍunā, satthena vā maraṇavadhena vā pana, ubbādhanāya paritajjanāya vā, na heṭhayī janatam'aheṭhako ahu.

43461.commentary: (THIa) paritappasī'ti santappasi, pure'ti yojanā. ayañ'h'ettha saṅkhep'attho, bhoti vāseṭṭhi, pubbe tvaṃ mataputtā hutvā socantī paridevantī ativiya sokāya samappitā gāma-nigama-rājadhāniyo āhiṇḍasi.

examples.text: petāni bhoti puttāni, khādamānā tuvaṃ pure, tuvaṃ divā ca ratto ca, atīva paritappasi.

examples.text: sabbasaṃyojanaṃ chetvā, yo ve na paritassati, saṅg'ātigaṃ visaṃyuttaṃ, tam'ahaṃ brūmi brāhmaṇaṃ.
so evaṃ asamanupassanto na kiñci loke upādiyati, anupādiyaṃ na paritassati, aparitassaṃ paccattaññ'eva parinibbāyati.

examples.text: atha kho, bho, mahāgovindassa brāhmaṇassa catunnaṃ māsānaṃ accayena ahu'd'eva ukkaṇṭhanā ahu paritassanā
so socati kilamati paridevati urattāḷiṃ kandati sammohaṃ āpajjati. evaṃ kho, bhikkhu, bahiddhā asati paritassanā hotī'ti.

43468.meaning1: anxiety and evasiveness; agitation and vacillation
43468.commentary: (DNa) tadapi tesaṃ bhavataṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ ajānataṃ apassataṃ vedayitaṃ taṇhāgatānaṃ paritassita-vipphanditam'evā'ti yena diṭṭhi-assādena diṭṭhisukhena diṭṭhivedayitena te somanassajātā sassataṃ attānañ'ca lokañ'ca paññapenti catūhi vatthūhi, tadapi tesaṃ bhavantānaṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ yathābhūtaṃ dhammānaṃ sabhāvaṃ ajānantānaṃ apassantānaṃ vedayitaṃ taṇhāgatānaṃ kevalaṃ taṇhāgatānaṃ'y'eva taṃ vedayitaṃ, tañ'ca kho pan'etaṃ paritassitavipphanditam'eva.

examples.text: tatra, bhikkhave, ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā sassatavādā sassataṃ attānañ'ca lokañ'ca paññapenti catūhi vatthūhi, tadapi tesaṃ bhavataṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ ajānataṃ apassataṃ vedayitaṃ taṇhāgatānaṃ paritassita-vipphanditam'eva.

kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, puggalo attan'tapo hoti attaparitāpana-anuyogam'anuyutto? idha, bhikkhave, ekacco acelako hoti mutt'ācāro hatth'āpalekhano na-ehibhaddantiko natiṭṭhabhaddantiko n'ābhihaṭaṃ na uddissakataṃ na nimantanaṃ sādiyati.
iti evarūpaṃ anekavihitaṃ kāyassa ātāpana-paritāpan'ānuyogam'anuyutto viharati. evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo attan'tapo hoti attaparitāpan'ānuyogam'anuyutto.

seyyathā'pi, māgaṇḍiya, kuṭṭhī puriso arugatto pakkagatto kimīhi khajjamāno nakhehi vaṇamukhāni vippatacchamāno aṅgārakāsuyā kāyaṃ paritāpeyya.

43494.commentary: (THa) yāva'd'eva sītavātaparittāṇaṃ, yāva'd'eva hirīkopīnapaṭicchādanaṃ katvā cīvaraṃ paribhuñjiṃsu.

examples.text: sītavātaparittānaṃ, hirikopīnachādanaṃ, matt'aṭṭhiyaṃ abhuñjiṃsu, santuṭṭhā itarītare.

43496.meaning1: little water; tiny amount of water

43497.synonym: appa, appaka, appamatta, appamattaka, oramattaka, khudda

examples.text: evaṃ parittakaṃ kho, rāhula, tesaṃ sāmaññaṃ yesaṃ n'atthi sampajānamusāvāde lajjā'ti.
pubbe jaṭilabhūtassa, yā me siddhi parittikā, t'āhaṃ tadā nirākatvā, pabbajiṃ jinasāsane.

43499.meaning1: with limited mind; with constricted mind; (comm) with an unwholesome mind

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā piyarūpe rūpe adhimuccati, appiyarūpe rūpe byāpajjati, anupaṭṭhitakāyassati ca viharati parittacetaso.
